title: Automattic's board forces CEO Matt Mullenweg into leave of absence
summary: Automattic's board has forced CEO Matt Mullenweg into a leave of absence, marking a significant corporate governance crisis at the company behind WordPress.com. This leadership upheaval comes amid ongoing tensions and disputes within the WordPress ecosystem.
problem_solved: This news item documents a major corporate governance event in the tech industry rather than solving a technical problem.
why_valuable: It provides insight into leadership turmoil at a major open-source company that powers a significant portion of the web, affecting millions of websites and the broader WordPress community.
